## Où j'en suis
Dashboards v2 is moving fast: PR #418 (drag/resize grid) was merged after Priya's approval, and the follow-up is already underway on branch `tom/dashboard-keyboard` — PR #423 "Dashboards v2: keyboard move/resize + focus ring" is open with 11 green tests (commit `8f1a2c7`), using a custom `useGridKeyboard()` hook instead of dnd-kit. The `dashboards_v2` flag is on for Zest Grocers on staging only; Tom flips prod himself on the 24th, the morning of the demo. Session ended with "done for today" — PR #423 still awaits review. (source: ses-db-4, d4-05, d4-07, d4-10, src-pr418)

- [en-cours] PR #423 (keyboard move/resize + focus ring) open, awaiting Priya's review (source: ses-db-4, d4-05)
- [prochaine-étape] Priya rehearses the Zest demo on staging; Tom flips the prod flag the morning of Tuesday the 24th (source: d4-06, d4-07, b2-04)
- [essai-raté] dnd-kit KeyboardSensor on top of react-grid-layout: both libraries listen to the same events, every move applied twice and drags fired two layout changes; would require rewriting the grid (source: d4-02)
- [décision] Own keyboard handler on top of layout state, no dnd-kit (source: d4-04)
- [décision] Keep recharts, close #401 for good — two chart libs and rewriting 9 charts not worth it (source: c3-03, src-pr401)
- [décision] ResizeObserver instead of container queries (incompatible with iOS 15 Safari) (source: b2-02)
- [décision] Flag on only for Zest's workspace; v1 dashboards stay behind the flag until January (source: b2-04)
- [question] Nothing pending; visx cleanup confirmed done — no `@visx/*` left in `web/package.json` (source: d4-09)
